// diagnostic

E0769

A label-only parameter, declared after `*`, was passed by position (D-APILABEL1)

What

A label-only parameter, declared after `*`, was passed by position (D-APILABEL1)

Why

The registered sema rule applies here

Fix

Follow the guidance for E0769

Worked example

First UI snapshot mentioning E0769: tests/ui/arg_label_required.stderr.

Error [E0769]: `timeout` is a label-only parameter of `connect`
  --> tests/ui/arg_label_required.jet:3:40
    |
  3 | fn run() { _ :: connect("db.internal", 5) }
    |                                        ^
 Why: the `*` in the declaration requires the label, so the call says what the value means
 Fix: write `timeout: …` for this argument
More: jet-lang.dev/e/E0769
